data.title: 椎名真昼 · 商业街并肩同行的微热红晕
data.description: 放学后一起采购食材的路上。真昼裹着象牙白牛角扣羊毛大衣和红格子围巾，双手缩在袖口里悄悄拉住你的衣角。两人的指尖在冬日寒风中无意相触，她整张脸颊瞬间泛起诱人的绯红，慌乱地偏过头看地砖。
data.location: 冬日繁华商业街林荫道
data.action: 双手缩在袖口轻拉衣角，围巾半掩脸颊，害羞低头视线躲闪
data.lighting: 冬日清亮冷暖交织的阳光穿过枯枝
data.camera: medium shot, winter coat, scarf, holding sleeve, heavy blush
data.promptProse: On the winter shopping street, blond Mahiru with a red plaid scarf and ivory duffle coat walks alongside a boy with cropped dark hair in a forest-green parka. She catches the edge of his coat and their fingertips brush, making her tuck her flushed face into the scarf. Low sunlight catches the tiled sidewalk beneath them.
data.animaCaption: Mahiru's blond hair and red plaid scarf frame her blush above the ivory coat. The short dark-haired boy beside her wears a forest-green parka, whose edge she catches as their fingers touch.
